LESSON: REPAIRING GARMENTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Repairing Garments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Repairing Garments. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
2. Give Kenyan examples for Repairing Garments
3. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: REPAIRING GARMENTS
This lesson teaches Repairing Garments for Grade 5 AGRICULTURE.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Repairing Garments
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Repairing Garments using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Repairing Garments above.
2. Explain Repairing Garments to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Repairing Garments.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Repairing Garments with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Repairing Garments important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Repairing Garments
2. Give Kenyan examples for Repairing Garments
3. Practise Repairing Garments at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
